name: Timewalking takes 4 seconds off Waves of Time's cooldown (#2143)
contract: Timewalking 572527 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints -4001 (die 1 => -4000 ms) and EffectSpellClassMask [4096, 8, 0]; Waves of Time 801277 is SpellFamilyName 28 with SpellFamilyFlags [0, 8, 0], so word1 bit 0x8 matches. The modifier is applied by AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod and reaches both the cooldown and the category cooldown in Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns, which matters because 801277 carries RecoveryTime 20000 and CategoryRecoveryTime 20000. No script is involved, so this is a regression check on the native modifier path. The other spell named by the issue, 800864, has no CharacterAdvancement entry, no module grant, no reachable trigger and no live-capture record and is not exercised.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Waves of Time keeps its 20 second cooldown without the talent
Timewalking brings the same cooldown down to 16 seconds
